sources: SBI careers page, official notices for the 2026-27 cycle: https://sbi.co.in/web/careers/current-openings

admitCard.where: From the SBI careers page (sbi.co.in/web/careers/current-openings), using your registration number and date of birth or password; no hard copy is posted
admitCard.when: Prelims call letters about two to three weeks before the exam; Mains and Phase-III call letters about ten days to two weeks before each stage
steps: Open the careers page (sbi.co.in/web/careers/current-openings) and click the call-letter link for Probationary Officers, Advertisement CRPD/PO/2026-27/09.
Sign in with your registration number and date of birth or password.
Download the call letter and the information handout, and print the call letter clearly.
Check your name, photograph, exam date, shift, reporting time and centre address, and contact SBI at once if something is wrong.
Keep each stage's call letter safe: the Prelims call letter, authenticated with ID proof at the Prelims centre, must be produced again at the Mains.
carry: The printed call letter for that stage
Photo ID in original plus a self-attested copy
Nothing else: phones, calculators, smartwatches and study material are not allowed inside
admitCard.note: Biometric verification (thumb impression or IRIS) may be done at the venue. For the interview stage, carry original documents including category certificates in the prescribed format; outstation candidates get AC-III rail fare reimbursement.

answerKey.summary: SBI does not publish the question paper or an answer key for the PO exam, and there is no objection window. Unofficial keys from coaching sites give only a rough estimate, since scores are normalised across shifts.
steps: Follow the result announcements on the SBI careers page.
Individual marks are shown through the official marks lookup page on the careers site when SBI activates it; enter your roll number and date of birth or password to download your score.
There is no provision for rechecking or re-evaluation of answers or scores.

result.summary: Each stage's result is a PDF roll-number list on the SBI careers page, with individual marks released separately through the official marks utility. Prelims marks are screening only and are not counted in the final merit.

stages.what: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour with 20-minute sectional timing (English 40, Quant 30, Reasoning 30). About 10 times the category-wise vacancies are shortlisted on aggregate marks, with no sectional cutoff. For 2026-27 the exam was held on 1 and 2 August 2026 and the result was declared in August 2026.

Objective paper of 170 questions for 200 marks in 3 hours with separate section timing, followed immediately by the typed descriptive paper (3 questions, 30 marks, 30 minutes). Held on 12 September 2026. Sectional cutoffs plus a minimum aggregate apply, and roughly 3 times the category-wise vacancies are shortlisted for Phase-III. Appearing in the Mains consumes one of the permissible chances.

stages.stage: Psychometric Test, Group Exercise and Interview
stages.what: Shortlisted candidates take a mandatory psychometric test (personality profiling with no marks), then Group Exercise (20 marks) and Personal Interview (30 marks), scheduled October/November 2026. Minimum qualifying marks in GE and Interview are decided by the Bank, and original documents are verified here.

Final merit out of 100: Mains (objective plus descriptive, 230 marks) converted to 75, plus GE and Interview (50 marks) converted to 25. Prelims marks are not counted and ties are resolved by age in descending order. The provisional selection list appears on the careers page, subject to medical fitness, background verification and the ₹2 lakh service bond for a minimum 3-year service; probation is 2 years.

result.scorecard: SBI publishes no cutoff lists for PO. Marks for each stage are available only to individual candidates through the official marks lookup page on the careers site, and are kept there for a limited period, so download and save yours.
